findings.claim: The waivers-path existence check at policy-check.yml lines 273-276 is dead code. The verify-bypass-pairing.sh script exits 1 when the waivers file is absent (script line 39), so if the script returned 0 the file is guaranteed to exist. The outer check is never reached.
findings.evidence: policy-check.yml lines 268-270: script invocation with `|| { emit_error ...; exit 1; }` — non-zero exits are caught here. Lines 273-276: `if [ ! -f "${SCP_WAIVERS_PATH}" ]; then emit_error SCP-E004 ...; exit 1; fi` — this block executes only after the script returned 0. scripts/verify-bypass-pairing.sh line 39: `if [ ! -f "${waivers_path}" ]; then echo ... >&2; exit 1; fi` — script exits 1 when file is absent. Flagged as C-nit-02 in R1 consolidation; expected-open because MIN/nit are not required closes.
findings.impact: No runtime impact. Misleads future readers into treating the outer check as meaningful defence-in-depth when it is unreachable.
findings.mitigation: Remove lines 273-276 from the bypass-gate step, leaving the script as the sole waivers-existence guard.

findings.claim: The SCP-E004 workflow log annotation at policy-check.yml line 327 uses the raw user-provided expires_at value in the human-readable 'until' field, while the structured bypass_record.waiver_expires_at in the summary artifact uses the normalized RFC3339 value produced by verify-bypass-pairing.sh. An operator comparing the workflow log to the artifact will see different expiry representations for the same bypass event.
findings.evidence: policy-check.yml line 327: `printf '::error file=%s,title=SCP-E004::break-glass bypass active for %s via %s until %s\n' "${SCP_WAIVERS_PATH}" "${BYPASS_RULE_ID}" "${decision_id:-D-unknown}" "${expires_at}"` — uses raw ${expires_at} (may be date-only e.g. '2026-06-01'). Lines 324-325: `append_github_env_multiline "SCP_BYPASS_EXPIRES_AT" "${waiver_expires_at}"` — writes normalized RFC3339 (e.g. '2026-06-01T00:00:00Z') to GITHUB_ENV. policy-check.yml line 481: `"waiver_expires_at": os.environ.get("SCP_BYPASS_EXPIRES_AT", "")` — artifact reads the normalized value. The annotation message and artifact record are cosmetically inconsistent.
findings.impact: No security impact. Does not affect bypass gate correctness, audit artifact integrity, or schema validation. Operators correlating log events with artifact records may be confused by format differences.
findings.mitigation: Change line 327 to reference ${waiver_expires_at} instead of ${expires_at}, so the log annotation and the artifact record both show the same normalized RFC3339 timestamp.

self_reported_concerns: MAJ-R2-BYPASS-001 closure: the two-layer defence (character check + heredoc) is sound. The character check provides early rejection before verify-bypass-pairing.sh is called; the heredoc write is safe against injection regardless of value content. Both layers are independently sufficient; together they form defence-in-depth appropriate for a break-glass gate.

MAJ-R2-BYPASS-002 closure: bypass_record is required by the schema when bypass_emitted=true via allOf if/then (schema lines 236-254). The workflow's missing-field check (lines 484-487) additionally prevents a malformed record from reaching schema validation. The allOf constraint has been verified by the dispatcher's schema round-trip test (exit_code=0 for both valid and missing-bypass_record cases).

MIN-R2-BYPASS-003 bonus closure: verify-bypass-pairing.sh line 84 now uses datetime.now(timezone.utc).date() for date-only expiry comparison, consistent with the datetime-path UTC handling. Considered closed.

append_github_env_multiline depends on uuidgen (from util-linux). On ubuntu-24.04 GitHub-hosted runners, uuidgen is available. Absence would cause the bash command substitution to fail under set -euo pipefail, producing an infra failure (SCP-E001 class) rather than a silent bypass. Not a new finding.

bypass_record.decision_id schema pattern is ^D-[0-9]{3}$; the sed extraction in verify-bypass-pairing.sh line 105 captures only D-0[0-9]{3} (zero-prefixed). The implementation is more restrictive than the schema, which is safe — no gap.

Conftest still lacks gh attestation verify (Sigstore) while OPA has it. Acknowledged at workflow line 158. This is a residual supply-chain risk carried from R1; it does not constitute a new CRIT or MAJ at R3 and is outside the break-glass bypass attack surface.
structured_review.summary: R3 confirms both R2 MAJ findings are closed. MAJ-R2-BYPASS-001 (GITHUB_ENV newline injection): closed by two independent defences — Python control-char check at policy-check.yml lines 257-265 rejects any rule_id containing \n, \r, or \x00 before the script is called; and append_github_env_multiline (lines 309-319) writes all four bypass env vars via uuidgen-delimited heredoc, making injection impossible regardless of value content. MAJ-R2-BYPASS-002 (bypass_emitted without structured record): closed by bypass_record object added to schemas/policy-check-summary.schema.json with allOf if/then requiring it when bypass_emitted=true, and the Build summary step (lines 477-489) populating all four required fields with non-empty validation before write. MIN-R2-BYPASS-003 (date.today() UTC drift in verify-bypass-pairing.sh) was also fixed as a bonus. Fresh R3 attack finds no new CRIT or MAJ surface. Two nit findings remain: nit-R2-BYPASS-004 (dead-code waivers-existence check, expected-open) and a new nit-R3-BYPASS-001 (log annotation uses raw expires_at while artifact uses normalized waiver_expires_at — cosmetic inconsistency). Fixpoint reached: APPROVED_WITH_FINDINGS (nit-only).
